arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: David Cole argued that regulators cannot add threats to requests for non-support.
Molly McDowell stated that officials may criticize speech but not threaten adverse action.
Nikhil Katyal countered that the insurers and NRA broke insurance laws by operating without licenses.

New York argues regulators may urge companies to assess reputational risks without violating the First Amendment.
